issues.text: Domain failures are handled with throw statements (missing review, invalid amount) instead of returning { ok: false, error } as required.
The service lacks the required doc comment stating its purpose and enumerating domain failure modes.
Error messages (bad id, bad amount) do not name what was wrong or what would be accepted, violating the API consumer standard.

result.reason: The document violates core behavioral and documentation requirements, specifically regarding exception handling for domain errors, missing documentation, and inadequate error messaging.
